description: This Java class implements a builder for creating responses and events related to live modification of features in the Eclipse Ditto project. It specifically constructs answers for the ModifyFeaturesLiveCommand, including success responses and error responses, as well as creation and modification events of features.

classes.name: ModifyFeaturesLiveCommandAnswerBuilderImpl
classes.description: A builder class for creating responses and events for a modify features live command in Eclipse Ditto. It provides methods to generate success and error responses and feature events.

classes.name: ModifyFeaturesLiveCommandAnswerBuilderImpl.ResponseFactoryImpl
classes.description: An internal immutable class implementing ResponseFactory to generate different command responses such as creation, modification, and error responses.

classes.name: ModifyFeaturesLiveCommandAnswerBuilderImpl.EventFactoryImpl
classes.description: An internal immutable class implementing EventFactory to generate feature created and modified events.
